metadata.title: Windsurf Rules for MoneyGraph: Cascade-Style Payment Integration
metadata.description: Configure Windsurf (Codeium) for MoneyGraph payment integrations. Learn how our Cascade rules teach Windsurf the SDK architecture and compliance patterns.
metadata.author: MoneyGraph Team

seo.og_title: Windsurf + MoneyGraph: Cascade Rules for Payment APIs
seo.og_description: Windsurf's Cascade engine understands MoneyGraph's namespace hierarchy, compliance rules, and task flows. Build payments faster.

content.intro: Windsurf (powered by Codeium) is the fastest-growing alternative to Cursor, known for its Cascade rules engine. MoneyGraph SDK v2.2 includes a comprehensive .windsurfrules.md file that teaches Windsurf our entire SDK architecture.

cascade_tags.example:
<coding>
  <rule id="init-pattern" severity="critical">
    Always initialize MoneyGraph with the constructor pattern.
  </rule>
  
  <rule id="typescript-strict" severity="high">
    Use strict TypeScript typing with MoneyGraph types.
  </rule>
</coding>

cascade_tags.description: Windsurf learns our entire namespace hierarchy
cascade_tags.example:
<architecture>
  <namespace name="customers" domain="Customer Onboarding">
    <sub_namespace name="kyc" domain="KYC Verification">
      <operations>submit, getStatus, uploadDocument, canPayout</operations>
    </sub_namespace>
  </namespace>
  
  <namespace name="payouts" domain="Outbound Payments">
    <sub_namespace name="swift" domain="SWIFT Transfers" />
    <sub_namespace name="mobileMoney" domain="Mobile Money" />
    <sub_namespace name="crypto" domain="Crypto Payouts" />
  </namespace>
</architecture>

<task name="Send International Payment">
  <flow>
    1. mg.customers.kyc.canPayout() - Verify KYC
    2. mg.fx.quote() - Get FX quote
    3. mg.fx.confirm() - Lock the rate
    4. mg.payouts.create() - Execute payout
  </flow>
</task>

how_it_works.heading: How Windsurf Uses These Rules
steps: Reads the architecture — Understands which namespace to use
Follows the task flow — Executes steps in order
Applies coding rules — Uses strict types and patterns
Checks compliance — Adds KYC verification automatically

example.prompt: Build a function to send money to Kenya via M-Pesa

why_windsurf.heading: Why Windsurf + MoneyGraph
why_windsurf.body:
Windsurf's Cascade engine excels at understanding hierarchical systems. Our SDK's namespace structure (mg.customers.kyc, mg.payouts.swift, etc.) maps perfectly to Cascade's mental model.

If you're building complex fintech applications with multiple payment rails, Windsurf + MoneyGraph is a powerful combination.
